bullets.text: 6G Pillars Unveiled - **Qualcomm** CEO outlines connectivity, computing, and sensing as foundational elements for future networks.

Military 5G Insights - Military deployments provide a model for resilient private networks in commercial settings.
AI-Centric Networks - **Huawei** launches solutions to prepare carriers for the agentic era at MWC 2026.
AI and 5G-A Convergence - **Huawei** discusses integrating AI into 5G-Advanced networks at MWC 2026.
Trust in AI Era - **Orange** CEO stresses the need for telecoms to build trust as AI becomes integral to society.
Cloud RAN Efficiency - **AT&T** trial shows AI enhances network efficiency, paving the way for better resource management.
AI-Driven Telecom Future - **Qualcomm** predicts a shift to AI-centric interactions as 6G networks evolve.
AI Solutions for Scams - Telecoms deploy AI to combat voice spoofing and synthetic voice scams effectively.
